notes.title: Post-Launch Bug Fixes and Difficulty Balance
notes.notes:
Hello Astronauts,



We've just pushed some bug fixes and gameplay balancing updates to our package, including:



Breathing will consume less oxygen.

You can now close the door of the spaceship, which will prevent oxygen from escaping.

We've added a Help Screen so you will have more information about the game and its mechanics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/e786302528a7281354db0ea8743f8695164ddec9.jpg"]



Hope you enjoy your survival in space!



Your Wondersoft Studio Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.01 - Death Menu Fix
notes.notes:
Hello Astronauts!

We fixed the issue with the death menu freezing input, so now you can die in the game without a hitch! No need to finish the game in one life anymore!

In the meantime, the "Quit" button in the pause menu will take you back to the main menu (instead of quitting the game).

Hope you have a better experience!

Your Wondersoft Team.

notes.title: Devlog Update: Diegetic Menus
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re still hard at work on the game, and we’ve made some great strides thanks to our playtesters feedback. The first playtests showed that the game was a bit too challenging, so we’ve been tweaking the difficulty to make it more enjoyable for everyone.

Right now, we have about 20 minutes of gameplay ready for you to explore. But, most important, we’ve also added diegetic (skeuomorphic) menus to keep you fully immersed in the world. These menus are integrated into the environment, making the experience feel more natural and seamless.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/d1273378cb5f3d29f50f87e6c8f5bf5c676e6c99.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/eec3d9c9dced2b5f05981b323020743fffd7df46.png


And here’s a little secret: we’ve improved the ending, but we won’t spoil it for you. You’ll have to play to find out! 😉

Thanks for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!
